package.name: PolarCNC
package.description: Polar (XZC) face machining and Wrap from the FreeCAD CAM workbench: a post-processor that turns a normal Job into polar G-code with G93 inverse-time feed, using the same converter as the web page. Also Knurling & Wrap: knurling and drawing wrapped round a cylinder, on a Part Design toolbar.

workbench.name: KnurlWrap
workbench.description: Knurling & Wrap: knurling on a cylinder and drawing wrapped round a cylinder, on a Part Design toolbar.
